hooks.name: Remind about interface-change rules
hooks.description: Adds a reminder only when an edit touches bridge.yaml or adds/changes a publisher, subscriber, service, frame or pixel_convention.

action.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.kiro/scripts/guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; python3 "$f" interface
